import sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp/tests')
import brutelib
routes = {(0,0):0,(0,128):1,(1,128):2,(2,128):3}
routes2 = {(0,0):0,(1,128):2,(2,128):3}
runs = brutelib.compile_runs(routes)
starts=[s for s,_ in runs]
bl=[(3,[1,1,1,2]),(11,[3,0,0,0])]
b1 = brutelib.brute_full(starts, bl, 2, 1, 9, [0,1,2])
p1 = brutelib.brute_pruned(starts, bl, 2, 1, 9, [0,1,2])
print("full v0:", b1)
print("pruned v0:", p1)
assert b1 == p1
runs2 = brutelib.compile_runs(routes2)
b2 = brutelib.brute_full([s for s,_ in runs2], [(5,[1,0,0,2])], 2, 1, 9, [0,1,2])
p2 = brutelib.brute_pruned([s for s,_ in runs2], [(5,[1,0,0,2])], 2, 1, 9, [0,1,2])
print("full v1:", b2)
assert b2 == p2
print("combined:", brutelib.combine([b1,b2], 2), " (expect work 135)")
